SCAM MUSEUM — 50 REALISTIC CHAT CASES
========================================================================

Purpose: manual copy-paste testing through the Scam Museum textarea.
Language: English-first.
These are synthetic test messages, not training data and not real scam records.

How to use:
1. Copy ONLY the text under MESSAGE.
2. Paste it into Scam Museum.
3. Click Analyze artifact.
4. Compare the result with EXPECTED / REVIEW TARGET.

========================================================================

CASE 01
EXPECTED / REVIEW TARGET: HIGH RISK
SCENARIO: Family impersonation
MESSAGE:
mum its me 😭 smashed my phone so this is my temp number. can u send £420 to this account today? i'll pay u back tomorrow x

------------------------------------------------------------------------
